User Story: As a user, I want to register and log in with role selection so that I can access role-based features securely.
Acceptance Criteria:
• The system allows users to select a role (Admin, Staff, Customer) during registration.
• User passwords are stored securely.
• The system validates required fields.
• Users only get access features permitted to their assigned role.

User Story: As a manager, I want to view a dashboard overview so that I can quickly monitor hotel operations such as bookings, room status, and revenue.
Acceptance Criteria:
• The dashboard displays summarized data such as total bookings, available rooms, and revenue.
• The dashboard reflects all the updates.
• The system displays a different dashboard based on user roles.
• Dashboard loads quickly and is accessible immediately after login.

User Story: As a manager, I want to manage room bookings so that I can reserve, update, or cancel rooms efficiently.
Acceptance Criteria:
• The manager can view all room bookings (confirmed, pending, and cancelled) in a centralized dashboard.
• The system allows the manager to add, update, or remove room availability.
• Error messages will be displayed for invalid booking operations.
• The manager can cancel bookings due to operational reasons.

User Story: As a manager, I want to manage system settings so that I can update hotel information, currency and pricing all together.
Acceptance Criteria:
• The manager can update hotel details such as name, address, email and contacts.
• The manager can select and update the currency symbol used across the system for pricing and invoices.
• The manager can update room service pricing, and changes are immediately reflected in billing and invoices.
• The manager can set and modify tax rates and ensure they are applied to billing operations.

User Story: As a manager, I want to add, update, and delete room details so that room inventory is maintained.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Admin can create rooms with numbers, type, price.
• Admin can update room details.
• Admin can delete rooms.
• Changes can reflect in real-time.

User Story: As a frontdesk staff, I want to search for guest details so that I can quickly access their booking information.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Frontdesk can search by name or id.
• System returns matching results.
• Guest details are displayed clearly.
• Search works quickly.

User Story: As frontdesk staff, I want to check room status so that I know which rooms are available, occupied, or under maintenance.
Acceptance Criteria:
• The system shows the room availability status.
• Rooms will be categorized by available, occupied or under maintenance.
• Status updates in real-time in the system.
• Staff can view the room status dashboard.

User Story: As a manager, I want to manage staff accounts so that roles and responsibilities are controlled.
Acceptance Criteria:
• The manager can create new staff accounts with required details.
• The manager can assign and update roles for each staff member.
• The manager can view a list of all staff along with their roles.
• The manager can deactivate or remove staff accounts when required.

User Story: As a hotel manager, I want to manage customer accounts so that I can view, update, and control guest profiles and their associated information efficiently.
Acceptance Criteria:
• The manager can view guest accounts by name or ID.
• The manager can update customer profile details such as contact information and preferences.
• The manager can deactivate or delete a customer account.
• All changes are saved in real-time and access is restricted to authorized roles only.

User Story: As a hotel manager, I want to view operational reports so that I can track revenue, occupancy, and bookings to make informed decisions.
Acceptance Criteria:
• The manager can access categorized reports (Revenue, Occupancy, Bookings) from the dashboard.
• Reports can be filtered by date range (daily, weekly, monthly, or custom).
• Each report displays accurate, up-to-date data in a clear and readable format.
• The manager can export or print reports in PDF format.

User Story: As a hotel manager, I want to create and manage discounts and offers so that I can apply promotional pricing and attract more guests.
Acceptance Criteria:
• The manager can create a discount with a name, type (percentage or fixed), value, and validity period.
• The manager can assign a unique promo code applicable during booking or checkout.
• The system automatically deducts the correct amount when a valid code is applied.
• Expired or invalid codes are rejected with a clear error message.

User Story: As a hotel manager, I want to generate and manage invoices so that I can accurately bill guests for all services and maintain clear payment records.
Acceptance Criteria:
• The system automatically generates an invoice at checkout with a full breakdown of all charges.
• Taxes and discounts are calculated and displayed as separate line items on the invoice.
• The manager can add, edit, or remove charges before finalizing the invoice.
• Finalized invoices can be downloaded as PDF and are stored in invoice history.

User Story: As a guest, I want to request room service through the system so that I can request for cleaning the room when I want.
Acceptance Criteria:
• The guest can submit a room service request for cleaning through the system.
• The system records the request with room number, date, and time.
• The guest receives confirmation after successfully submitting the request.
• The request is visible to staff for processing and status updates (e.g., pending, completed).

User Story: As a hotel manager, I want to track room service and housekeeping requests so that I can manage tasks efficiently and avoid delays.
Acceptance Criteria:
• The staff dashboard displays all pending service or housekeeping requests.
• Requests show guest details, room number, and task type.
• Staff can update status (e.g., accepted, in-progress, completed).
• System logs timestamps for request creation and completion.

User Story: As a guest, I want to place different types of orders (food, drinks, amenities) so that I can enjoy hotel services conveniently.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Guests can browse categorized items (food, drinks, amenities).
• Orders can be customized (e.g., add-ons, portion size).
• The system calculates total cost before confirmation.
• Guests receive digital confirmation of the order.

User Story: As a guest, I want to view my expenses during my stay so that I can monitor my spending and prepare for checkout.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Guests can view a detailed list of all charges (room, food, services).
• Expenses are updated in real-time after each transaction.
• The system shows breakdown by category (room, dining, housekeeping, extras).
• Guests can download or request a digital copy of expenses.

User Story: As a manager, I want to track staff attendance and shifts so that I can manage employee working hours efficiently.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Staff can easily check in and check out without confusion.
• The system clearly shows who is present, absent, or late.
• Shift timings are visible so staff know when to work.
• The manager can quickly review attendance history anytime.

User Story: As a manager, I want to manage breakfast, lunch, and dinner timings so that services run smoothly without overcrowding.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Meal timings are clearly set and easy to understand.
• Guests and staff can see when each service starts and ends.
• The system helps avoid too many people coming at once.
• Staff get reminders so they can prepare on time.

User Story: As a customer, I want to browse available rooms so that I can choose a suitable room before booking.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Rooms are displayed in a simple and easy-to-browse way.
• Important details like price, type, and features are clearly shown.
• Availability is updated so users don’t see already booked rooms.
• Images help users understand what the room looks like.

User Story: As a guest, I want to give feedback and reviews so that I can share my experience and help improve services.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Guests can easily leave a rating after their stay.
• Writing a review feels simple and quick.
• Feedback is stored so management can review it later.
• Admin can see common issues and improve services.
